d:
I haven't posted anything in a while, and now I've finally finished another comic. It tells an alternate ending to the film "Kimetsu no Yaiba" — Demon Slayer. I'd love your feedback, but remember that this comic is aimed at a fairly narrow audience of fans of this kind of thing, so if you don't like that kind of thing, don't write or read it. The rest of you can enjoy it.

Oh, and I haven't forgotten about the previous comics and their sequels, but your feedback will determine which one I finish first.

Fuxdess
n: [Misc] Shinobu Kocho became Doma's demon by Fuxdess (Part 1) [Ai generated]
